rule_title: TTP 1069.001 - Local Group Enumeration via SAM RID Brute Force (CrackMapExec)
description: Detects CrackMapExec enumerating local groups by iterating SAM_ALIAS objects via RID brute force. The attack opens a SAM_SERVER handle, then a SAM_DOMAIN handle for the Builtin container, then requests handles to each SAM_ALIAS (local group) object sequentially. A burst of SAM_ALIAS handle opens from a single subject within a short window is the automated RID cycling fingerprint.
